questions.prediction: Before running cart, propose what one tick does to position and velocity. Name a probe that distinguishes using the old velocity from using the updated velocity. Record your reason and uncertainty.
questions.model: Describe the one-tick model you implemented. Connect an instruction or branch to an observed result. Record the cases you tested and one limitation.
questions.transfer: Before revealing transfer source or a worked answer, predict how cart-transfer differs. Choose a discriminating probe, record the observed result, and explain whether your old model still fits.
questions.challenge: Investigate cart-crossing after saving two competing rules and a distinguishing prediction. Preserve observations, instruction evidence, a model attempt and any repair. Predict a fresh multi-tick run before executing it. Explain which alternatives your evidence rejects and which remain uncertain.
